jobs.description: Work Your Magic with us!Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.Your roleAre you passionate about biology and data science and eager to make a real impact on cancer research? As an Intern in Computational Oncology, you will work at the intersection between biology and data science. You will collaborate with a dynamic team of scientists to analyze and interpret complex datasets and contribute to the discovery of new therapeutic strategies. In particular, you will be combining multi-omics data to identify new drug targets and support our early research programs.The position is based in Darmstadt, Germany.Who you are•    You are currently enrolled as a student and pursuing a master’s degree in biology, biotechnology, medicine, molecular medicine, computational biology, bioinformatics, or a related field.•    You have a demonstrable understanding of molecular biology.•    You are proficient in R and have experience with AI-assisted coding and analysis workflows, including the responsible use of large language models to support code development and documentation.•    You have hands-on experience with omics data analysis and relevant bioinformatics tools.•    You are an enthusiastic, creative, goal-oriented, pro-active and an out-of-the-box thinker with a strong ability to work collaboratively.•    You have excellent English communication skills. Both written and spoken.Duration: 4-6 monthsLocation: Darmstadt, GermanyAdditional Information: A valid work permit is required for the internship.What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.occupation: Postdoc Positions in Attosecond Pulse Generation at EuXFEL (Physiker/in)
jobs.description: For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:Postdoc Positions in Attosecond Pulse Generation at EuXFELRemuneration Group 13 | Limited: 3 years | Starting date: 04.01.2027 | ID: MPO007/2026 | Deadline: 30.11.2026 | Full-time/Part-timeDESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.The European XFEL is one of the world's leading free-electron laser facilities and provides intense X-ray pulses with durations down to the attosecond regime. A dedicated strategy program has been established to further develop and exploit these ultrashort pulses, including through recruitment of new expertise. The positions focus on advancing existing techniques for short-pulse generation in terms of power, pulse duration and stability and both the hard and soft x-rays. Key areas of research include:- Independent control of transverse and longitudinal dispersion- Development of advanced pulse-shaping techniques- Advancing the use of existing longitudinal diagnostics for short-pulse characterizationAbout your role:These positions combine scientific R&D with hands-on machine development and operation, providing the opportunity to take new FEL concepts from simulation through experimental validation to routine operation.- Conduct simulations and eventual experiments towards short pulse production at the EuXFEL- Actively support other attosecond generation activities- Communicate results and insights through presentations, reports and publications- Encouraged to develop and pursue their own ideas- Contribute to the reliable daily operation of the facility as an operatorAbout you:- PhD in physics or related field with a background in accelerator or FEL physics- Experience with relevant FEL simulation codes- Good communication skills and a collaborative approach to working in an interdisciplinary team- Good command of English, German is beneficial- Experience in attosecond pulse generation- Practical experience in the FEL field- Experience in cathode shaping, fresh-slice or laser beam modulationGood reasons to join:Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our staff are central to us, with gender equality forming a key part of this commitment. To support work life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.For further information please contact Marc Guetg (marc.guetg@desy.de (https://mailto:marc.guetg@desy.de) ).Please submit your complete application documents (letter of motivation and research interests, CV, list of publications, relevant certificates and three letters of references). Please use our online tool for the submission of the letters of reference: Additional application documents (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/134822/2/892)We look forward to receiving your application via our application portal:Apply now! (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/134822)DESY promotes equal opportunities, diversity and inclusion (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/134822/2/2544) . We therefore welcome applications from people of all dimensions of diversity. The professional development of women (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/134822/2/2820) is very important to us and therefore we strongly encourage women to apply for the vacant position. Applications from severely disabled persons and those with equivalent status will be given preference if they are equally qualified (sbv.desy.de (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/134822/2/780) ).You can find further information here:https://www.desy.de/career/apprenticeship/ (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/134822/2/3781)Deutsches Elektronen-Synchrotron DESYHuman Resources Department | Notkestraße 85 | 22607 HamburgPhone: +49 40 8998‑3392 (https://tel:+494089983392)

Your primary responsibility is to serve as the strategic link between Merck's Corporate Trade Compliance organization and the business functions operating in highly regulated markets — in particular the Life Science business in Russia and other sanctions-exposed segments.You design, implement and continuously improve Internal Compliance Programs (ICPs) for assigned sanctions regimes, embedding governance structures, controls and operational safeguards directly within the business organizations that own day-to-day execution. In this capacity, you act as a trusted partner and advisor to the business organizations who are responsible for running these programs, providing them with structured guidance, oversight and escalation support.Beyond your program governance responsibilities, you coordinate cross-functional efforts across enabling functions — including Finance, HR, Tax and IT — to address sanctions exposure themes that extend beyond the Trade Compliance perimeter, such as financial flows, employee screening, technology transfer and jurisdictional nexus. You facilitate the establishment of cross-functional project teams, represent the Sanctions Compliance team in internal governance forums, and ensure that relevant process owners across the organization are identified, engaged and equipped to fulfill their compliance obligations.You develop and deliver training programs and communication frameworks that translate complex regulatory requirements into practical, business-oriented guidance. You conduct compliance gap assessments, monitor regulatory developments in close collaboration with Corporate Legal and Government Affairs, and translate legislative changes into actionable program-level impact assessments.Where the role requires it, you also provide legal advice and guidance on sanctions compliance matters — interpreting applicable EU and US sanctions regulations, advising on licensing strategies, and liaising with external legal counsel and regulatory bodies. However, the primary emphasis of this position is on program governance, organizational implementation and cross-functional coordination rather than on legal counselling as a standalone function.Who You Are:- You hold a university degree in Law, Business Administration, Economics, International Relations, or a related field — candidates with a legal background as well as those with a strong commercial or operational profile combined with deep sanctions compliance expertise are equally welcome to apply.- You have at least 8 years of professional experience in trade compliance, export controls, sanctions compliance or a closely related field within an international corporate environment.- You bring solid knowledge of EU and US sanctions regulations and export control requirements, including licensing frameworks and the procedures of competent export control authorities.- You have a proven track record in program management and governance design — you know how to build compliance structures within business organizations and drive their implementation across complex, cross-functional environments.- You are a strong communicator and stakeholder manager, able to engage credibly with senior management across business sectors and enabling functions, and to translate regulatory complexity into clear, actionable guidance.- You combine a commercial mindset with compliance rigor — you understand business needs and are able to act as a trusted partner to the business rather than solely as a control function.- You are proactive, structured and resilient, comfortable navigating ambiguous regulatory environments and managing multiple priorities simultaneously.- Fluency in English and German is required; additional language skills are an advantage.What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.occupation: Account Manager Graphics (m/f/d), Neschen Coating GmbH (Account-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Worldwide Sales & New Business Development Neschen, part of Henkel, develops and manufactures self-adhesive graphic media and coating solutions. Our portfolio includes printable media, protective laminates and mounting films for applications in signage, retail graphics, displays and visual communication. To accelerate our international growth, we are looking for a commercially driven Account Manager with a clear hunter mindset. You enjoy approaching new customers, understanding their applications and turning opportunities into profitable, lasting business. What you will do Win new customers: Identify, approach and win distributors, graphics-material suppliers, print service providers and customers with relevant graphics applications. Engage end customers and specifiers: Build relationships with retailers, brand owners, designers, architects and agencies. Understand their projects, provide advice, samples and application support, and establish Neschen products in material selections and specifications. Turn projects into sales: Work with distributors, print service providers and application partners to convert product selections into orders and repeat business. Develop international markets: Build growth plans for priority markets, recruit suitable distribution partners and expand our portfolio within existing accounts. Lead the sales process: Own every step from prospecting and qualification through trials and commercial proposals to negotiation and closing. jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Expert SAP S/4HANA Cloud Environment Engineer (f/m/d) to join our Business Services (https://jobs.pwc.de/de/de/interne-dienstleistungsbereiche)  division starting from March 2026.Your responsibilitiesResponsibility – As a part of the Product & Technology team, you will deploy and configure SAP BTP services. You will cooperate with business analysts, developers, and deployment teams to prevent and resolve technical issues, ensuring integration and optimization across platforms.Automation - You support the automation tools from SAP BTP (e.g. Build Process Automation) and drive continuous improvement with additional suitable tools. You implement security measures, ensure compliance, and engage stakeholders with clear, focused communication.Solutions – You define guidelines, standards, and manage infrastructure to deliver and maintain SAP S/4HANA-based processes and solutions, ensuring end-to-end integration and optimization within the cloud environment.Innovations – You assess emerging cloud technologies, evaluate SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and SAP BTP innovations, and drive continuous improvement by leveraging tools for automation and efficiency.Your profile- You have completed your studies in computer science, economics, or a comparable field.- You bring several years of experience in SAP BTP management and SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud integrations.- You have in-depth knowledge of modern technologies such as cloud management platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.- You have in-depth knowledge of modern technologies such as cloud management platforms, especially SAP Business Technology Platform- You have extensive experience in configuring and optimizing SAP BTP to SAP S/4HANA integrations.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written.- Your analytical, independent, and structured approach to work supports you defining guidelines. Furthermore, your communication enables effective collaboration with various teams.Your benefitsFlexibility – We encourage you to choose your working hours and your working place the way that suits you and your lifestyle. We do not have core working hours and we also offer you the possibility of home office or temporary work from abroad. Always in accordance with operational requirements and labor law regulations. Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website.At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society. As part of our internal IT team (Products & Technology), you are the driver behind our promise: human-led and tech-powered. We are experts for our technology solutions and make the use of technology easier and more efficient. As a team, we develop innovative solutions for the entire product life cycle and manage the use of technology in the organization. Drive the technological development of PwC Germany in our diverse teams!ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.
